title: Shifted-square obstructions at indices divisible by 17 or 41 in a family of Lucas sequences (repository archive)
description:
Repository archive containing the corrected v1.0.1 article and supporting v1.0.0 evidence, including exact-arithmetic certificates, PARI/GP and Python replay checks and Lean 4 sources for the theorem that F_N(A)-1 is not an integer square when A is congruent to 2 modulo 4 and N > 0 is divisible by 17 or 41, in the family F_0(A)=1, F_1(A)=A, F_{n+2}(A)=2A F_{n+1}(A)+F_n(A), with an application to the exact Pell exponent in a square-middle powerful-number family. The article text, explanatory guide and data are CC BY 4.0; the code is Apache-2.0. The human Hilbert-reciprocity proof is not itself Lean formalised; the Lean development covers the integer-Jacobi and recurrence exclusions and their propagation.

CC BY 4.0 covers the article, explanatory guide, proof record and data or certificates. Apache 2.0 covers the original code. Embedded materials retain their notices. See the repository’s licence and file coverage.
